title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Role: Analytics Architect

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Full Time


Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.

Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.

Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.

Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.

Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.

Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.

Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).

Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.

Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.
Planejar sprints, gerenciar o fluxo de tarefas e acompanhar a evolução técnica dos desenvolvedores.
Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.
Atuar ativamente no código (Full Stack) para acelerar desenvolvimentos críticos ou resolver gargalos técnicos da equipe. Qualificações
Habilidade em planejamento de desenvolvimento de software, gestão de desenvolvedores e garantia de entregas.
Sólida experiência como Desenvolvedor Full Stack.
Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).
Visão de testes e qualidade de código.
Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.
Comunicação clara para alinhar expectativas com a equipe de desenvolvimento e stakeholders.
Perfil de dono: você assume a responsabilidade de amarrar todas as pontas do projeto para garantir o sucesso final. Desejável
Experiência prévia atuando como Tech Lead ou liderando equipes técnicas.
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos de startups e metodologias ágeis.
Noções de negócios e produto. Diferencial da Vaga
Modelo de Parceria nos Resultados: Além da remuneração, você receberá bônus atrelados à performance dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Você receberá bonus percentual atrelado com o lucro líquido dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Uma excelente oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento e ter impacto direto na qualidade e no sucesso dos produtos que construímos.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.
Requirements:
Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
Attention to detail is a must (!!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode
Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
Join a supportive team.
Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
12 paid vacation days per year as part of your total compensation package.
Growth Opportunities and Full Training.

title: Medical transcription evaluators
description:
Role: Medical Transcription Evaluators
Location: Remote
Language : Portuguese-Brazilian
Job Type: Contingent (Hourly/Project-Based)
About the Role:
The objective of this project is to have human evaluators listen to short audio clips of AI-generated speech (~30 seconds each) and correct the corresponding transcriptions. This ensures that the final transcript accurately reflects what was spoken, with a strong focus on quality and accuracy of medical terminology.
Required Skills:
Strong linguistic and transcription expertise
Familiarity with medical terminology in the language Portuguese-Brazilian
High attention to detail and accuracy in transcription Proficiency:
L3 with strong medical transcription experience Education Background:
Medical background or degree preferred Work Experience:
Previous transcription experience, ideally in medical or healthcare-related projects

title: Csod
description:
About NIIT
At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.
NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.
Link to NIIT Linked In page -
Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Social seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digitalVocê é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?
Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Desenvolvedor backend sênior node
description:

Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Type Script e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.
What you will do
Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed What you will bring to the role
Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities Your experience
Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
Bachelor's degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.
Requirements:
Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
Attention to detail is a must (!!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode
Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
Join a supportive team.
Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
12 paid vacation days per year as part of your total compensation package.
Growth Opportunities and Full Training.

title: Desenvolvedor backend sênior node
description:
Esperado para o cargo
Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Espera-se que este profissional garanta a estabilidade e a performance das aplicações Back-end (Node.js), dissemine boas práticas de engenharia (como Clean Code e SOLID) através de Code Reviews rigorosos e atue como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores de níveis Júnior e Pleno, elevando a barra técnica do time sem perder o foco na entrega de valor para o negócio.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Type Script e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.
Realizar Code Reviews detalhados, garantindo a qualidade do código, segurança e a conformidade com os padrões arquiteturais definidos.
Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) para garantir a confiabilidade das entregas.
Atuar na investigação e resolução de incidentes críticos em produção (troubleshooting), bem como na otimização de performance de rotinas e banco de dados (No SQL).
Apoiar tecnicamente a gestão de produto na viabilidade de novos requisitos e colaborar na estimativa de esforço das tarefas da squad. Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando Node.js e Type Script.
Domínio na construção de APIs RESTful e uso de frameworks como Nest JS ou Express.
Vivência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria (AWS SQS/SNS ou similares).
Experiência com bancos de dados No SQL (Mongo DB), incluindo modelagem e otimização de performance.
Conhecimento sólido em serviços da AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB, S3).
Prática habitual de escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
Habilidade com Git, fluxos de Code Review e ambientes de CI/CD. Diferencial:
Experiência com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes).
Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou Serverless Framework).
Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic ou Cloud Watch).
Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL) ou caches (Redis).
Conhecimento em práticas de segurança de aplicação (OWASP). Modelo de Contratação:
Regime: PJ + Benefícios.
Localização: 100% Remoto

title: Medical transcription evaluators
description:
Role: Medical Transcription Evaluators
Location: Remote
Language : Portuguese-Brazilian
Job Type: Contingent (Hourly/Project-Based)
About the Role:
The objective of this project is to have human evaluators listen to short audio clips of AI-generated speech (~30 seconds each) and correct the corresponding transcriptions. This ensures that the final transcript accurately reflects what was spoken, with a strong focus on quality and accuracy of medical terminology.
Required Skills:
Strong linguistic and transcription expertise
Familiarity with medical terminology in the language Portuguese-Brazilian
High attention to detail and accuracy in transcription Proficiency:
L3 with strong medical transcription experience Education Background:
Medical background or degree preferred Work Experience:
Previous transcription experience, ideally in medical or healthcare-related projects

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.

description:

At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content

Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs

Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve

description:

As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions.
You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. (
TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills.
This is a high-ownership role where you'll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products.
You'll get to manage multiple Saa S products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team.

Interview engineering candidates.
Code during crunch times. What You'll Bring:

Experience with data systems (SQL/No SQL), messaging technologies (e. g. , Kafka), containerized environments (e. g. , Kubernetes) and UI technologies.
Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools.
Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent
Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems.
Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products.
Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period.

Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing
We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you.

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally.
SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Summary
We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.
Responsibilities
Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance Qualifications
2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities

title: Senior data scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis, essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Tipspace
A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:

Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.

→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário

→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)

→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito

100% Remoto
