title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Competitive hourly rate
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
i Merit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.
Role Responsibilities:
Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards. Skills & Competencies:
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools. Requirements:
Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of
Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage
you to apply!

title: Senior data scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis, essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Tipspace
A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

title: Data analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.
They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!
Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
2 years experience creating and deploying custom Power BI dashboards
Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Business/B2+ Level English
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
High level of numeracy and attention to detail
Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
Strong Power BI (Power Query, M, DAX)
Microsoft Fabric
Strong analytical and documentation skills
Python Scripting skills (Pandas, Num Py, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
Power Shell scripting (desirable)
SQL skills (desirable)
Developer skills (desirable)
Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
Good Power Point and presentation skills

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence
Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement What You'll Be Doing
Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live
Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice
Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements
Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery
Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready
Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap What We're Looking For
Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist
A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles
Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements
Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders
Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous. Why Apply?
Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth
Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team
Have real influence over product direction and client success
Fully remote role with international collaboration
Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
Benefícios:
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Previdência Privada;
Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;
Auxílio alimentação;
Aconselhamento financeiro;
Clube de vantagens;
Auxílio Home Office;
Auxílio Mobilidade;
Auxílio Criança;
Seguro de Vida;
Licenças estendidas;
Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Analista de sistema (pleno)
description:
ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS PLENO | CIBERIAN TECNOLOGIA
Vaga também para PCD
Há 24 anos transformando o mercado de tecnologia!
A Ciberian Tecnologia é uma das referências no setor de Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação, especializada em fornecer soluções inovadoras que integram pessoas, processos e tecnologia. Desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas;
Atuação em ambiente Cliente-Servidor;
Desenvolvimento Web com. NET (MVC, Web Services e arquitetura em 3 camadas);
Criação e manutenção de rotinas em Oracle (PL/SQL);
Correções, melhorias e evolução de sistemas. Requisitos Técnicos:
Ensino Superior completo em TI;
Conhecimento em Cliente-Servidor e Programação Orientada a Objetos;

Conhecimento em ferramentas como SVN, Jenkins e Redmine;
Vivência com sistemas tributários;
Experiência com Visual Basic;
Familiaridade com Gene Xus. Por que escolher a Ciberian?
Valorizamos as relações humanas e o desenvolvimento profissional;
Ambiente que incentiva a inovação e criatividade;
Projetos desafiadores com impacto real na sociedade;
Cultura colaborativa e de aprendizado contínuo;
Comprometimento com a excelência técnica. Benefícios:
Benefício flexível para alimentação/refeição (i Food);
Plano de saúde;
Assistência odontológica;
Assistência psicológica;
Parcerias educacionais;
Totalpass (benefício com academias, psicólogos e nutrição);

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Application developer - mendix
description:
Accepting CVs in English Only.
Job Level: Independent Contributor, 3 Years minimum experience
English Level: C1 (Professional)
Location: Remote, Contractor (Brazil, Colombia or Latin America countries only)
Application Developer – Mendix
The Application Developer - Mendix will work across teams to design, develop, and implement Applications leveraging Mendix low-code / no-code platform as part of the Integration and Development team within the client's Technology department. This candidate will collaborate with internal client teams and work with external consultants when needed to deliver web and mobile solutions for various client business units.
The Application Developer – Mendix will be responsible for developing and maintaining solutions built upon the Mendix platform, as well as responsible for integrating with SAP, Mulesoft and a wide variety of systems internally. This role will also be required to build processes to account for change control, governance and development of best practices for all Mendix applications built for internal and external use.
Responsibilities:
Design, code, test, and deploy software applications based on business requirements using Mendix low-code platform.
Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
Design intuitive user interfaces and efficient back-end workflows.
Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.
Maintain and improve the performance and reliability of existing applications.
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
Integrate Mendix applications with external systems and APIs.
Participate in agile development cycles, including planning, sprints, and reviews.
Troubleshoot issues and provide maintenance support for existing applications.
Implement best practices for coding, security, and performance.
Write technical documentation and user guides as needed. Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3+ years of experience in Application Development.
Mendix Rapid Certification Required
Mendix Intermediate Developer certification (Preferred).
Proficiency in Mendix microflows, nanoflows, and domain modeling.
Experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of low-code development principles and agile methodology.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Java Script, or other front-end technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Design, code, test, and deploy software applications based on business requirements using Mendix low-code platform.
Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.

Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.
Maintain and improve the performance and reliability of existing applications.
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
Integrate Mendix applications with external systems and APIs.
Participate in agile development cycles, including planning, sprints, and reviews.
Troubleshoot issues and provide maintenance support for existing applications.
Implement best practices for coding, security, and performance.
Write technical documentation and user guides as needed. Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3+ years of experience in Application Development.

Proficiency in Mendix microflows, nanoflows, and domain modeling.
Experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs.

Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Java Script, or other front-end technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Coordenador de compras
description:
Quem somos
A Valuement, parte do Grupo Mantu, é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais, ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em processos de Finanças e Procurement.
O Grupo Mantu, fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diferentes setores e regiões do mundo.
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos um Coordenador de Compras para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais, liderando processos estratégicos de procurement e identificando oportunidades de otimização, redução de custos e melhoria de contratos e relacionamentos com fornecedores.
Suas responsabilidades:
Gerenciar sourcing e procurement de categorias estratégicas nos clientes
Revisar e negociar contratos, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e melhoria de processos
Colaborar com áreas de Finanças e Jurídico dos clientes para garantir conformidade e eficiência
Desenvolver KPIs para acompanhamento da performance de fornecedores e da eficiência do procurement
Apoiar a definição de roadmaps de compras alinhados à estratégia de cada cliente
Participar de projetos corporativos e negociações estratégicas
Ser o principal elo entre Procurement, Financeiro, Jurídico e demais stakeholders Seu perfil
Experiência em procurement estratégico, supply chain ou sourcing
Habilidades de negociação e comunicação
Conhecimento avançado de sistemas ERP ou de compras (SAP, Totvs, Oracle)
Capacidade analítica com experiência em análise de gastos, otimização de processos e redução de custos
Perfil de liderança e habilidade para gerenciar equipes ou projetos interfuncionais
Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos O que oferecemos
Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
Uma cultura baseada em confiança, onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR), especialmente por meio do programa We Care Together Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!
Diversidade & Inclusão
A Valuement tem orgulho de ser uma empresa de oportunidades iguais. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma força de trabalho diversificada e um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, recebemos candidaturas de todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Direct response ads | video editor
description:
About Hydroh:
We're one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.
Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.
We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Tik Tok, and You Tube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we're talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.
Compensation & Perks:
Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
Fully Remote
Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people. What We're Looking For
2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, Tik Tok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
Clear communicator and proactive with timelines Bonus Points:
Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
Editing for long-form VSLs What you'll be doing:
Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and Tik Tok
Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed How to apply?
Apply directly via Linked In
Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works
We're looking to hire immediately — so if you're an editor who gets performance, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior software engineering manager
description:
About the Job
As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions.
You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. (
TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills.
This is a high-ownership role where you'll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products.
You'll get to manage multiple Saa S products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team.
You Will:
Be in charge of the given quarterly budget, dictating how many engineering contractors that you can/want to have on the team.
Interview engineering candidates.
Code during crunch times. What You'll Bring:
(Preferred qualifications)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g. , Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices.
Experience with data systems (SQL/No SQL), messaging technologies (e. g. , Kafka), containerized environments (e. g. , Kubernetes) and UI technologies.
Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools.
Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent
Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems.
Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products.
Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.

title: Supervisor(a) de customer success
description:

Estamos em rápido crescimento e buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Customer Success para liderar a operação de atendimento B2 B, garantindo excelência na experiência do cliente, retenção e expansão de receita.
O que você vai encontrar ao fazer parte da Branddi:
Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!
Ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor: Valorizamos e incentivamos novas ideias. Sua contribuição é essencial para nós!
Espaço para inovação: Buscamos sempre melhorar nossos processos e fluxos, e contamos com você para ajudar nesse processo de aprimoramento.

Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto.
Bônus mensal por resultados.
Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience
Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);

Full-Stack Developer (Ruby and React)
100% remote | PJ
>>> Only resumes in english
- Strong expertise in Ruby on Rails at production scale;
- Proven AWS infrastructure experience (systems that don't wake you up at night);
- Solid skills with React/Redux for full feature delivery;
- Deep understanding of Postgre SQL and performance optimization;
- Experience integrating AI tools into development workflow;
- Strong communication and ownership mindset;
- Work with EST timezone.
Responsibilities
- Own full-stack features from database to browser;
- Optimize data layers to eliminate performance bottlenecks;
- Improve Rails architecture for long-term maintainability;
- Build scalable AWS-based data pipelines;
- Deliver high-quality, production-ready React/Redux features;
- Use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Jules, Factory) as part of your daily development workflow;
- Communicate clearly and work independently in a high-ambiguity environment.
Would be a plus
- Experience modernizing legacy Rails systems
- Familiarity with system design and long-term infrastructure planning
- Track record of optimizing query plans and execution times

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst
English Resume Only
Location: Brazil
Type: Full-Time Contract
Setup: Fully Remote
Level: Mid-Level
Industry: Software SAAS Company
Shift: US Hours
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment: Available upon request
Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000
About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.
About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.
Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.
Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.
Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.
Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes. O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes. Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade. Modelo de trabalho
Atuação majoritariamente em campo, com base em home office e disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Alteryx server specialist - latam based
description:
Position Summary
Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.
Position Overview
We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Responsibilities:
Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows. Qualifications:
Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Director of studies
description:
TTA (The TEFL Academy), is the world's largest TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) teacher training company. Over 15,000 English speakers complete our TEFL qualifications each year and start exciting careers teaching English abroad or online. Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others.
We are looking for a remote Part-Time (20hrs per week) Director of Studies to join our team. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development.
You will manage the teaching team, oversee lesson quality and assessment standards, and ensure that all academic processes align with industry best practices. You'll play a critical role in teacher recruitment, training, curriculum development, and the ongoing professional development of our staff.
Key Responsibilities Academic Leadership
Provide strategic academic direction
Lead the development and continuous improvement of curricula and teaching resources
Maintain and raise academic quality standards across the programme Team Management & Development
Recruit, train, and manage a team of TEFL trainers
Mentor newly qualified trainers, providing structured onboarding and ongoing support
Deliver in-house training and CPD sessions for teaching and assessment staff
Observe and assess teacher performance, offering developmental feedback Assessment & Quality Assurance
Design, implement, and maintain clear assessment rubrics aligned with learning objectives
Monitor assessment consistency and integrity across the teaching team
Ensure timely, constructive feedback is provided to learners Operational Oversight
Allocate teaching and assessment assignments efficiently
Manage timetabling logistics in line with teacher availability and learner demand
Coordinate with internal teams (e.g. tech, admin, student support) to ensure smooth academic operations
Use IT systems (including ticket lines and online teaching platforms) to manage workflows and communication Problem-Solving & Communication
Take initiative in identifying and resolving academic or operational challenges
Communicate effectively with multiple departments to ensure alignment across functions
Adapt quickly to changing needs, especially during peak periods and across multiple time zones Requirements Essential:
TEFL qualification
DELTA or Dip TESOL qualified
Extensive experience teaching General English to adults online & in-person
Proven track record in teacher training, mentoring, and academic leadership
Experience observing and assessing teaching practices
Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment Desirable:
Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows
Background in recruiting and managing academic staff What We Offer
A senior leadership role in a dynamic, growing international education company
Opportunities for professional development and career progression
Fully remote working arrangement
Flexible working hours, particularly during off-peak periods

Buscamos um desenvolvedor. NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.

⸻

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando. NET Core
• Trabalhar com APIs REST de forma estruturada e performática
• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo
• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade
• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo
• Colaborar com outras áreas (produto, dados, operações) para entregar soluções completas
• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema

• Domínio prático de. NET Core e C#
• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST

• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento

Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: Onboarding specialist - contractor
description:
About Sleek Flow
Join Sleek Flow, a thriving Saa S startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Associate Level
Location: Brazil

Educating customers and optimizing their product setup for the quickest path to success.

Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner.
Build evergreen content and resources for customers (and other organizations) to use for education and to drive rapid product adoption.
Be a Sleek Flow expert and discuss or educate on any nuance of the product internally and externally.
Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements Skills and Qualifications
Good command of both written and spoken Portuguese and English

Competitive base package
20 working days per month
Fun and diverse culture
International team environment
Constant & rigorous training from experience team leads Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework
Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Csod
description:
About NIIT
At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.
NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.
Link to NIIT Linked In page -
Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
